messages:
Lena: quick design ask for the Serving Wins launch next Thurs. Need a tidy asset pack: hero slide (1920x1080), a single-panel benchmark diagram (cost vs latency), editable slide master, three social crops, email header, and a one-page SDR sell-sheet. include export PNG + SVG and alt text. deadline: Tue EOD for first pass. @Marco @Tasha
Marco: noted. do we show competitor names or anonymize? need the CSV for plotting.
Lena: anonymize competitors into two clusters, highlight our recommended config. CSV link: https://docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d/EXAMPLE_ANALYTICS (view granted).
Tasha: brand rules: use Redwood Blue for primary lines, Ink for type. no gradients on charts; icons from brand set only. stacked logo on hero, horizontal for footers.
Rico: short hero copy: "High-performance inference: faster responses, lower cost." Use that for hero; variants for socials.
Sam: UTMs: utm_source=webinar&utm_medium=social&utm_campaign=serving_wins_q2. HubSpot mapping: hs_lead_source="Webinar: Serving Wins", hs_campaign="serving_wins_q2", hs_tags="webinar_servingwins_q2". will provide embed.
LegalBot: please attach API run IDs / provenance for any comparative claims. will review once provided.
Marco: i'll deliver 3 initial hero comps and the benchmark diag thumbnail by Tue 5pm; exports PNG @2x + SVG. will add alt text in Figma.
Lena: thanks — tagging review order: Design -> Brand -> Legal -> Ops. ping when uploads ready :rocket:
notes: Compact kickoff for launch assets and benchmark diagram; includes UTMs, HubSpot mapping, and legal provenance request.
